product_context.name: galaxy
product_context.description:
The Samsung Galaxy M35 5G is a mid-range smartphone designed for users who want a balance of performance, entertainment, connectivity and everyday usability. It offers a large Super AMOLED display, a high refresh rate, a capable processor, a high-capacity battery and a camera with optical image stabilisation. It is suitable for everyday communication, multitasking, entertainment and general smartphone usage.
Specifications: - Display: 6.6-inch Super AMOLED
- Refresh rate: 120Hz
- Processor: Samsung Exynos 1380
- RAM: 8GB
- Storage: 128GB
- Battery: 6000mAh
- Rear camera: 50MP main camera with OIS
- Front camera: 13MP
- Connectivity: 5G
- Operating system: Android with Samsung One UI

response_text: It offers good performance and features for daily use, but the price might be a bit high.
